description: Step 1 of 2 to send money to a saved recipient (list_recipients / prepare_recipient). Gets a live quote and checks Wise's requirements. Nothing is written to Wise yet: this returns a summary and a one-time confirmation_code. Show the summary to the user and call confirm_action ONLY if the user explicitly approves it in their next message. Confirming creates the transfer in Wise UNPAID: the user then pays it in the Wise app, so money only moves after that.

extra_details.description: Extra fields Wise requires on some routes, e.g. transferPurpose, sourceOfFunds (a previous attempt lists them)

profile.description: Default: the profile the recipient belongs to

receive_amount.description: Amount the recipient should get, in their currency

reference.description: Reference the recipient sees (max length depends on the route)

source_currency.description: Currency to send from (default: the recipient's currency)

name: prepare_transfer

pay_in_options.description: Price per payment method, cheapest first (methods with the same price merged)

target.description: What the recipient gets, when paid from the Wise balance

summary.description: Show this to the user before confirming

title: Prepare a Wise transfer
